title: The doughkat suvival kit
description: so its a modpack for a sever that is for my guild but very fun to play with singleplayer too
body:
This modpack is a custom modded survival experience designed for use on my Minecraft server. It focuses on enhancing vanilla survival gameplay while keeping the core Minecraft feel intact, making it suitable for both new and experienced players.

The pack includes a carefully selected combination of performance, quality-of-life, and survival enhancement mods. These improvements aim to make gameplay smoother, more engaging, and more enjoyable without drastically changing the original mechanics of Minecraft. Players can expect better performance, improved UI elements, and additional survival features that expand exploration, building, and progression.

The goal of this modpack is to create a balanced multiplayer survival environment where players can collaborate, explore, and build together. It is intended for a private/community server but is being shared through Modrinth for easy installation and access for players.

All included mods are widely used and sourced from reputable mod developers. The pack does not include any harmful, malicious, or inappropriate content. It is purely focused on enhancing gameplay experience, stability, and enjoyment.

This modpack is regularly updated based on server needs and player feedback to ensure compatibility, stability, and an enjoyable survival experience for everyone involved.
